rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP C The Rectification by Accidents and Speculum
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author begins a distinct numbered nativity-rectification chapter based on accidents and an astrological speculum.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Printed Chapter C is editorial/sequential CI, not the earlier Animodar chapter.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: by Transits of Planets upon principal Hylegiacall places
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly describes a competing birth-time correction through transits to principal hylegical places.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Mentioned method, not endorsed.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: figure of Profections directing ascendant and Mid-heaven
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A second competing method uses profections of the Ascendant and Midheaven to promissors.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Do not conflate profection with the method Lilly favors.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: could never finde any verity or probability
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly explicitly reports finding no reliability in either transit- or profection-based correction in his practice.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Unquantified author opinion, not a controlled demonstration of zero predictive performance.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He refers readers interested in those discarded methods to Origanus.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The referenced passage has not been reaudited.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He cites John Schoner's attempt to rectify his own birth chart using profections.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One historical self-case, not a verified independent outcome.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He also cites Pezelius for earlier practical descriptions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The precise source identity and text remain unchecked.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He recommends using significant personal events that have already occurred to rectify a natal chart.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Retrospective curve fitting: those same events cannot establish out-of-sample predictive accuracy.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: collect so many as he can procure and eminent ones
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He asks for as many significant life events as can be obtained.
rules.original_source_qualifications: An open event-selection set creates flexibility; denominator is not frozen.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: certaine time ... yeer and moneth day
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Ideally the events have known year, month, and day.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Precise date is preferred but not required.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: moneth and yeer will well serve
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly permits using only month and year when no exact day is available.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Increases accepted timing tolerance.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: accept of the yeer without moneth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If needed he allows a year-only event date.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Very broad timing window; not equivalent to a day-specific hit.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: For bodily conditions he prioritizes illnesses, misfortunes, and physical calamities.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Retrospective outcomes; not current clinical diagnoses.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Ascendant and its progression supply the significator for bodily accidents.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The progressed degree is chosen from an estimated natal chart.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A planet encountered by conjunction or aspect supplies a promissor associated with the adverse event.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The source includes interpretive classification of promissors.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: he shewes greatness and quality of accident
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The selected promissor is said to indicate severity and kind of event.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independent association or calibration.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The discussion of what a significator promises continues over the prior physical page boundary.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One continuous source passage.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Midheaven (MC) is an alternate natal significator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Must remain distinct from Ascendant.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Medium Celi ... Promittors for honour Preferment Marriage
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He directs the MC to promissors for status, promotion, and marriage.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Outcome-class choice is part of the method's flexibility.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: cannot well be rectified but by Accidents ... one or both Angles
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He strongly favors life-event correction using one or both major angles.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical practitioner confidence not independent validation.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Sun is also counted a principal hylegical significator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Additional available predictor family.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Moon is another principal significator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Distinct from Sun and angles.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Part of Fortune is included among main directional points.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Derived point, not independently observed planet.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: these five ... Hylegiacall or principall places
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The five are Ascendant, MC, Sun, Moon and Part of Fortune.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One source definition of the candidate set.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: affaires ... in quality What and measure of time When
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says their directions describe both kind and timing of human affairs.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical theoretical claim, not independently established.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: best Method I do know ... draw a Speculum
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says his preferred practical approach starts with a speculum made for the estimated birth time.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-selected method; not a prospective calibration procedure.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: place Planets Cuspes houses according to estimative time
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Populate all planetary places and house cusps from the estimated chart.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Astronomical/house geometry must later be reconstructed.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: care to rectifie place of Moon
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He stresses correcting the Moon's position for the estimated clock time.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Birth-time-dependent lunar placement.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: frame Speculum ... so many lines as you see
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Construct a tabular worksheet of as many lines as useful.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The hand-built sheet's size and inclusions are discretionary.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: An Astrological Speculum of our Nativity
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A large twelve-column chart shows natal planetary aspects, terms and future directed contact positions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Primary numeric/graphical source witness; all glyph coordinates are retained in the original JPEG.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The zodiac signs form successive 30° columns across the full 360° ecliptic.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The 0–30 degree row indexing is continuous through signs.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The left-most table column includes degree and minutes of sign.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Some rows have minute offsets, not uniform exact degrees.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Symbols of Planets Terms and Aspects
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The grid includes term ruler glyphs and traditional aspect positions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: These hand-entered markups are not an independently validated aspect database.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The worksheet includes antiscia and contra-antiscia signs such as 'An.' and 'CA'.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Reflection formulas/glyphs need independent diplomatic and mathematical checking.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A 'M.C.' label near 14°39 marks the Midheaven in the natal speculum.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The sign and exact row should not be invented from a low-resolution chart.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Moon glyph appears at 1°44 in the worksheet, consistent with the earlier merchant figure.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Chart derived from source estimates.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The chart marks the natal ascendant near 6°37 of its sign.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Estimated chart; later author intentionally adjusts it.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: manual speculum glyphs thousands of potential intersections
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The original sheet encodes many candidate contacts over multiple signs, rows and aspect types.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One-image-page documentary record cannot be counted as complete machine-readable extraction of individual placements.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: place characters twelve Signes in order
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Begin the Speculum with all twelve zodiac sign headings in their usual order.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A fixed header order despite variable rows.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: first column Deg Min ... minutes adhering
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Use the first column for sign degrees and attached minutes.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Maintain sexagesimal precision.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: every Sign place Termes every Planet proper degrees
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Insert each planetary term ruler at its correct sign-degree boundary.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Requires historical essential-dignity term table page 104.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly illustrates terms beginning at Aries zero with Jupiter as ruler.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Glyphs must be checked from the actual 1647 table.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A Venus term begins in the seventh degree of Aries.
rules.original_source_qualifications: His 'in seventh' convention means preceding six whole degrees finished.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury terms are said to begin at the fifteenth degree of Aries.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Boundary defined from preceding term's end.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars terms begin at the twenty-second degree of Aries.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source specific degree boundary.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn's terms begin at the twenty-seventh degree and continue to end of Aries.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Boundary series should be reproduced exactly if numeric registry is built.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: At a new term starting degree, the former ruler loses power and the successor takes over.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Inclusive/exclusive degree convention matters to runtime.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He warns contemporary astrologers often shift term entry by one degree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A specifically documented historical off-by-one failure mode.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter enters Libra twelfth not eleventh
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He illustrates the mistake using Jupiter's term in Libra, which starts in the twelfth degree rather than eleventh.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Potential direct acceptance test for source-era term boundaries.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: aspect both forward backward or direct converse
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Populate planetary aspects in zodiacal order and against it, named sinister/direct versus dexter/converse.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Two direction families, not interchangeable.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Forward and converse aspect placement depends on sign succession.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source condition for later direction computation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn ninth degree and two minutes Taurus
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly locates Saturn near Taurus 9°02′ in his source nativity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: An estimated chart longitude, not independently verified ephemeris data.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn sextil sinistr by adding sixty
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author's first forward sextile point is Saturn longitude plus 60 degrees.
rules.original_source_qualifications: An angular ecliptic geometry operation.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The forward square point is source longitude plus 90°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical aspect rule.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Trine by one hundred and twenty
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The forward trine is longitude plus 120°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical aspect rule.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Opposition at one hundred and eighty
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The opposition is opposite longitude plus 180°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Circular longitude wrap is required.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Other square, sextile and trine points are computed in reverse zodiacal order.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Separate from forward/sinister aspects.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun Jupiter Mars Venus Mercury Moon send aspects
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The method is repeated for six further visible classical planets.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One full candidate family, not six independently observed cases.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: neither Pars Fortunae Nodes emit irradiation
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly excludes the Part of Fortune and lunar nodes from emitting their own aspectual rays.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Do not invent aspects for those derived points.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A semisextile is one of the additional minor directional aspects considered.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Numeric angle given on following page.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Semiquintile is among the additional aspects.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not the same as traditional conjunction/sextile/square/trine/opposition.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Semisquare appears among the supplementary aspects.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Requires 45° not standard 90°.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Quintile is included.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical angle 72° on next page.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sesquiquintile is included.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical angle 108°.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Biquintile is included.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical angle 144°.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sesquisquare is included.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical angle 135°.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Speculum one side of paper could not contain
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says the shown sheet is too small to mark all minor aspects explicitly.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Example incompleteness is acknowledged; more candidate matches exist than displayed.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: private use a very large Speculum
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He encourages constructing a larger worksheet containing old and new aspects.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Further flexibility and researcher discretion.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ten twenty degree rows sign offsets
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He maps sign start degree offsets to 10°, 20° etc. in repeated columns.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Arithmetic rows allow translating 0–360 to sign plus degrees.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Semisextile angular separation is 30°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One of seven explicitly listed minor angles.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Semiquintile separation is 36°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical invariant.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Semisquare separation is 45°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical invariant.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Quintile separation is 72°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical invariant.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sesquiquintile separation is 108°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical invariant.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sesquisquare separation is 135°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical invariant.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Biquintile separation is 144°.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source numerical invariant.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly converts natal Moon Gemini 1°44′ to full zodiac longitude 61°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source astronomical datum, not independently recalculated.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Forward minor aspects are found by adding each angular difference to 61°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Pure circular degree arithmetic.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Moon semisextile at 91°44′, Cancer 1°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source internally checkable.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Semiquintile point at 97°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Cancer 7°44′.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Semisquare point at 106°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Cancer 16°44′.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Quintile point at 133°44′.
Sesquiquintile point at 169°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Virgo 19°44′.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sesquisquare point at 196°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Libra 16°44′.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Biquintile computed result should be 205°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Page546 example prints what appears to be 105°44′ although subsequent page says 205°44′; retain discrepancy and audit individual glyphs.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: One first-edition worked calculation appears as 105°44′ for a 144° addition to 61°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Numerically impossible; correct sum 205°44′ and source PDF547 subsequently uses 205°44′. Do not silently erase.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Quintile from Moon 61°44′ maps to Leo 13°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Heading/source line includes unusual '30 degrees' phrasing; use actual angular position.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sesquiquintile from Moon maps to Virgo 19°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sesquisquare from Moon maps to Libra 16°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The following source page explicitly uses 205°44′ = Libra 25°44′ for Moon's biquintile.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Corrects page546's apparent typo while retaining each witness.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: For reverse/dexter aspects, subtract each angle from the Moon's 61°44′ ecliptic longitude.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Separate direction from forward.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: For angles larger than source longitude, add 360° before subtraction.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Modulo 360 convention.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dexter semisextile maps to Taurus 1°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dexter semiquintile maps to Aries 25°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dexter semisquare maps to Aries 16°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dexter quintile maps to Pisces 19°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source. Add 360 first.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dexter sesquiquintile maps to Aquarius 13°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dexter sesquisquare maps to Capricorn 16°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dexter biquintile from Moon maps to Capricorn 7°44′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source arithmetic check.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The same minor-aspect coordinate process is repeated for the other six classical planets.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Allows many possible promissor targets.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If an aspect sum exceeds 360°, subtract 360 and place marker at remainder.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Modular arithmetic.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: tedious explanation student with no Master
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly explains detail because he found it difficult as a student.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Authorial narrative, not statistical claim.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He tells the astrologer to list past accidents chronologically.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Prior events act as inputs, not out-of-sample targets.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly gives a hypothetical young-child illness example.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Illustrative, not the merchant's recorded case.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He gives a second flexible childhood example, even allowing a range of months.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Broad potential event tolerance.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An event's type is used to choose a supposedly corresponding planet.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Interpretive categorization can shift retrospectively.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Diseases and Hurts by Ascendant Promittors
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Illness and physical injury are fitted using directions of Ascendant to relevant promissors.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Ascendant branch.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Preferment Office Command Marriage by Mid-heaven
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Career advancement, authority and marriage are fitted using directions of the Midheaven.
rules.original_source_qualifications: MC branch, separate from physical accident.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Merchant gave these Accidents and no others
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says the anonymous merchant provided only the events that follow.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Author assertion of a limited set; no independent survey/case documentation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: master of quality aged 16 years 7 months
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: First merchant event: entered service to a respected master at age 16y7m.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Target used in birth-time fitting; not independent validation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: journey beyond sea aged 20 years 4 months
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Second merchant event: concerning overseas journey at 20y4m.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Target known in advance.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Third merchant event: a burning fever reported at 20y10m.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Conflicts with a later direction described for 19y10m10d; retain explicit mismatch.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: another Fever melancholly Scurvy aged 24 years 11 months
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Fourth merchant event: later fever, melancholy and scurvy at 24y11m.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical labels not modern confirmed medical diagnoses.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: other material Accidents could not remember
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly reports the merchant did not remember other material accidents.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Incomplete self-report and potential selection bias.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly begins with the merchant's first reported advancement event to examine the Midheaven.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Event is a calibration target known before matching.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The natal Midheaven is given at 14°39′ Scorpio.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One source chart position; no independent house reconstruction.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Midheaven's equatorial right ascension is 222°10′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical right ascension data, not independently ephemeris-verified.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: run down column Midheaven to Promittors
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He scans candidate promissors in the MC column of the Speculum.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Multiple comparisons; selection after knowing event.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: One nearby candidate is a Venus term reached after ~0°21′ direction.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Early candidate not chosen as event explanation.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Another candidate Mercury term is reached by ~7°25′ direction.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Would correspond to ~7 years 5 months under usual convention.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A Saturn term is a possible direction around 13°34′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Another alternative to selected career event.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars contra-antiscion direction appears around 14°43′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Another direction candidate.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The directed MC encounters eleventh-house cusp at roughly 15°38′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Other event/career symbol option.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Jupiter term shares the ~15°38′ arc with the eleventh cusp.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Overlapping potential interpretations not independent cases.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The MC reaches a trine to Mars at roughly Sagittarius 0°54′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Chosen event-related promissor despite other earlier candidates.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: subtract RA Midheaven from RA Promittor
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Directional arc = right ascension of the promissor minus MC right ascension.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Requires signed/modular subtractions.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly gives Mercury term direction as 7°25′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Integer degree/minute subtraction independently checkable.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He chooses Mars because Mars is tenth-house ruler tied to work and status.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The choice is made with the career target in view.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: first no benevolent direction to Mars until Sagittarius
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He notes absence of earlier favorable Mars direction before Sagittarius.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Dependent on selected promissor and allowed aspects.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The table gives RA ~238°51′ for Sagittarius 1° before fractional interpolation.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source printed tabular arithmetic.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The two source right-ascension tabular endpoints differ by 1°03′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Interpolation bracket used in worked example.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The chosen Mars trine lies 54 arcminutes into Sagittarius.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source planetary configuration, not independently recalculated.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly uses proportional interpolation: 63′ times 54/60.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Pure numeric interpolation.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The proportional RA increment is 56.7′, rounded to 57′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Rounding source matches arithmetic.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The corrected Mars-trine right ascension is 238°45′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Printed source arithmetic consistent.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Subtracting Midheaven RA gives a directional arc 16°35′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source arithmetic consistent.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: This direction measure assigns one calendar year for each degree of equatorial arc.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical symbolic correspondence, not a verified real-time age mapping.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly mentions six days per arcminute when converting fractional arcs to time.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Approximate 360-day solar-year scaling, not a modern Gregorian-year calendar.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: 16 degrees 35 minutes gives 16 years seven months
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The 16°35′ direction is interpreted as roughly age 16y7m, fitting the master's apprenticeship/promotion event.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Calibration hit using a previously supplied event; not out-of-sample.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He emphasizes MC directions to promissors ordinarily use right ascension.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Specific to MC class.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun Moon Planet within one degree cusp
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: For a planet close to a house cusp, he introduces a different circle of position/oblique-ascension treatment.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Potential exception to simple RA-only calculation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: oblique ascensions or descensions belonging Elevation
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: House-cusp-adjacent directions require latitude-specific oblique ascensions/descensions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Locational latitude prerequisite.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Ancients give each equatorial degree a year
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He attributes the year-per-degree timing convention to ancient astrologers.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical attribution, not independently validated causation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: five minutes of arc one month
